notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB234): the residue that kept this PARTIAL - legal source REFUSED - is gone. An ADDRESS-OF-taken record of a RECURSIVE unit's static working-storage (13.5.4 GR1: one static copy) routes its StorageCell - the record's ONE storage, which ManagedPointer.At aliases - onto the static channel (DataBinder.StaticAddressableCells), and __ResetStatics re-seeds it IN PLACE from the declaration's own VALUE image with its managed slots cleared (StorageCell.Reinitialize; 14.6.2.3.2 action 2), so after CANCEL the next CALL finds W back at its VALUE while a pointer taken before the CANCEL still names the one copy. A level-01 REDEFINES of a BASED record in the same unit (the other arm of the deleted COBOL0899 recursive-working-storage-pointer-backed reject) rides the based root's static bridge. pb234_recursive_address_of_static runs it: the recursive activation's ADDRESS OF W equals the outer one's (SAME), last-used state survives a plain return (ENTRY=WXYZ D=2), and CANCEL restores the initial state (ENTRY=ABCD D=1). The other initial-state actions stay evidenced by recursive_ws and pb154_cancel_initial.
